create_vasp_relax_inputs: create VASP relaxation input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional
create_vasp_static_inputs: create VASP static calculation input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional
run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the CLI tool to generate VASP inputs from a directory of CIF files
create_input_generator: create a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator from an INCAR YAML configuration file
review_create_vasp_inputs: review the create_vasp_inputs script for VASP input generation from CIF files
